As we normally do, I'd like to hear from each of you before I make my final decision. Could the requesting teacher, our instructional technology specialist, and the business-office manager please report any relevant findings on the proposal? I'll need your input on the equipment quantities, the software platform, the funding, and the installation timeline.

I completed a trial this week with the enrolled section, and it showed that all 12 students need simultaneous stations — each student requires one laptop and one USB microphone. I recorded the results in my classroom planning log, though I should note that log was not attached to the capital request. So the draft request for 10 laptops would not be sufficient; we'd need 12 laptops and 12 USB microphones to serve the full section.
